headline: Bruins collapse at the Garden while the Celtics face Game 7 tension
morning_brew: The Bruins are out after a 4-1 loss to the Sabres. Getting bounced in the first round by Buffalo is a total disastah. We have six Cups in this city, but this group looked like they forgot how to play playoff hockey when it mattered. Jeremy Swayman made twenty-two saves, but you cannot win when the offense only gives you one goal from David Pastrnak. It is another early exit, and frankly, it is embarrassing for a team with this much history to go out like that.

It all comes down to tonight at the Garden. Game 7 against the Sixers is the only thing that matters right now. We are chasing Banner 19 and we need Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown to play like the superstars they are. Philadelphia is not just going to roll over, especially with Embiid back in the mix. The Garden needs to be absolutely electric because a loss tonight would be a stain on this era of Celtics basketball. Let us hope they show up with some real grit.

At least the Sox gave us something to smile about at Fenway. Jake Bennett was fantastic in his big-league debut, giving up just one run over five innings. Jarren Duran provided the fireworks with that three-run blast to secure the 3-1 win. Meanwhile, that plane flying the sell banner over the Fens shows exactly where the fans are at with ownership right now. Over in Foxborough, the draft is in the books and we are waiting to see if these new guys can help us get back to the six Lombardis we are used to seeing.

news_digest.headline: Sabres beat Bruins 4-1 in Game 6 to reach 2nd round for 1st time since 2007
news_digest.dans_take: A total collapse for the B's against a team they should have put away.

news_digest.dans_take: The kids are alright at Fenway Park and Bennett looks like the real deal.

news_digest.dans_take: Everything is on the line tonight at the Garden and there are no more excuses.

news_digest.dans_take: The fans are frustrated and they are making sure ownership hears it from the sky.
